compiler.name: Emscripten
compiler.note: The provided compiler override was used; the build script default SDK remains unchanged.

benchmark.limits: CPU view projection, homogeneous clipping, area sorting and pixel allocation, including validation and buffer copies; excludes scene extraction, draw submission and GPU time. Not target-device FPS.

editorBrowser.includes: Four actual WebGL rendering/pixel tests, WASM view budgets, 3,000-deep hierarchy and 20-session resource cleanup.

standaloneBrowser.command: PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE=/usr/bin/chromium node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/composition/browser.mjs tests/foundations/browser.mjs tests/package/browser.mjs tests/portal/browser.mjs tests/rendering/browser.mjs
standaloneBrowser.includes: Near-plane portal coverage, gameplay, package loading, lighting lab and rendering resource cleanup.

productionBuild.note: 4 GiB is the build process heap limit; no runtime memory limit was changed.

verification.browserScope: Headless Chromium with ANGLE SwiftShader. Correctness and lifecycle verification only, without a target-device GPU/FPS claim.
verification.execution: Browser suites ran serially with runtime source fixed to prevent CLI runtime synchronization from triggering development-server hot reloads.
